limits: Synthetic local SQLite and immediate ESI adapter; no external service or real pilot data.
Core, projections, stream sanitization and SSE encoding/chunking are the actual production implementations.
Client sinks model consuming local SSE clients, not browser parsing/layout or TCP backpressure.
100/1000/10000 directory entries and 10/50 configured widgets are declared small/populated/stress fixtures, not claims about a typical user.
Frozen Date.now keeps no-work projection values stable; explicit freshness controls advance it separately.
Counter wrappers never run inside ordinary timing; elapsed numbers are diagnostic component costs, not end-user FPS or whole-app CPU.
